findings.operation: A valid Dodge request during SkeletonAction::Dodge is accepted without begin_authoritative_quickstep, then charges ExplosiveDodge workload again and rewrites response timestamp. No per-action charge identity or consumed notification exists in this handler.
findings.case: Admitted repeated direct FromClient<DefendRequest> while a healthy actor has a current dodge, valid direction, required components and available viewer: first and repeated accepted commands can charge work against the same running animation and refresh reflex timestamp. With conditional ordinary mass80kg/carried0/endurance3 and pinned authored fatigue defaults, each workload is1960J and adds about.040833 fatigue until capped; no actor with those exact values or network replay was executed.
qualifications: PlayerInput projection intentionally begins quickstep first then triggers DefendIntent for initial charge. Existing-Dodge branch is therefore intentional for the first begun-action notification; simply rejecting every already-Dodge intent would lose ordinary player quickstep workload.

Do not claim routine client repeats this direct DefendRequest, nor bypass of PlayerInput jump sequence guard. This is actual permitted network ingress command behavior, not a demonstrated client-frequency or live-session failure.
This is per-action operation correlation, distinct numeric fatigue-overflow ROOT-INITIAL04-F030. No guessed global unique finding count.

findings.connected_repair: Correlate defense admission/workload/response publication with the actual begun dodge identity or an explicit once-consumed transition result across direct client, prebegun PlayerInput and AI paths. findings.acceptance: First legitimate prebegun PlayerInput notification and direct/AI dodge begin charge once for their actual action; repeated receipt for that same action does not add action work. Preserve intentionally most-recent response timestamp/consumption semantics unless canonical owner explicitly changes that policy. Invalid admission leaves action/work/response unchanged except explicitly harmless acknowledgement. Preserve roll policy separately; no blanket rejection of already-started actions.
